adm_grw_title: 🎡 Wheel, lotteries and trust channel Tap an item to change it.
adm_grw_ask_value: Send the new value for {name}. Current: {value} Send "-" to clear or reset to default.
adm_grw_trust_hint: This option sets one trust channel; for several channels with their own report kinds, use the panel's channels page.
adm_grw_bad_value: That value is not accepted. The spin interval must be 1 to 720 hours and the channel ID a number like -1001234567890.
adm_grw_prizes_needed: Set up at least two valid wheel prizes first.
adm_grw_prizes_title: 🎁 Wheel prizes Each prize's chance comes from its weight.
adm_grw_prize_ask: Send the prize on one line like this: Title | wallet | 10000 | 30 Kind: wallet (credit in toman), discount (1-100 percent) or nothing. The last number is the weight (1-1000).
adm_grw_prize_bad: The prize format is wrong. Example: 10% off | discount | 10 | 20
adm_grw_prize_min: The wheel needs at least {n} prizes with a positive weight.
adm_grw_lots_empty: 🎟 No lottery has been created yet.
adm_grw_lot_ask: Send the lottery on one line like this: Title | prize description | credit amount | winners | join | days join means customers press a join button; purchases means every order in the period is a ticket. The credit can be 0.
adm_grw_lot_bad: The format is wrong. Example: November draw | 50 GB service | 0 | 3 | join | 7
adm_grw_lot_ended: The lottery is closed; winners are drawn and notified on the next scheduled run.
adm_grw_lot_not_open: This lottery is no longer open.
adm_grw_lot_disabled_hint: Note: lotteries are switched off in settings, so customers will not see it until you turn them on.
